{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] ground meat (e.g. [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]], [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]])
* 2 cans (29 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]]
* 2 cans (29 ounces) [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]] (with liquid)
* 2 cans (29 ounces) [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]] (with liquid)
* 2 cans (29 ounces) [[Cookbook:Pinto Bean|pinto beans]] (with liquid)
* 2 cans (29 ounces) diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 2 cups water
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 stalks [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], diced
* 3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]] powder
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
# Cook the ground meat in a large pot on medium-high heat.
# Drain off and discard the fat.
# Add all remaining ingredients in order and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Reduce to low heat and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 2 to 3 hours, stir every 15 minutes.
